description: Cancels a backtest that is still running, like Cancel on acubic.ai: the allowance it used is returned and the previous saved result stays. Needs the run_id from acubic_run_backtest. To remove a strategy use acubic_delete_strategy.

strategy_id.description: The strategy the run belongs to.

name: acubic_cancel_backtest

refunded.description: Whether the run's allowance was returned; null when not reported.

title: Cancel a running Audit (backtest)
